{"python": "import re

# Load validation cohort clinical data (Patients 81-128) from Table S1
rows_s1 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page9')
print('Table S1 header:', rows_s1[1])
print('Total rows:', len(rows_s1))

# Extract TRG for patients 81-128
trg_map = {}
for r in rows_s1[2:]:
    name = str(r[0]).strip() if r[0] else ''
    m = re.match(r'Patient[- ]?(\d+)', name)
    if m:
        pid = int(m.group(1))
        if 81 <= pid <= 128:
            trg_val = str(r[7]).strip() if len(r) > 7 and r[7] is not None else ''
            trg_map[pid] = trg_val

print(f'Patients 81-128 found: {len(trg_map)}')
print('Sample TRGs:', {k: trg_map[k] for k in sorted(trg_map.keys())[:10]})

# Check for cCR annotations
ccr_patients = set()
for r in rows_s1[2:]:
    name = str(r[0]).strip() if r[0] else ''
    m = re.match(r'Patient[- ]?(\d+)', name)
    if m:
        pid = int(m.group(1))
        if 81 <= pid <= 128:
            full_row = ' '.join([str(x) for x in r if x is not None])
            if 'cCR' in full_row or 'ccr' in full_row.lower():
                ccr_patients.add(pid)
print('cCR patients in 81-128:', sorted(ccr_patients))

# Also check if TRG column has non-numeric values
non_numeric = {pid: v for pid, v in trg_map.items() if not re.match(r'^[0-3]$', str(v))}
print('Non-numeric TRG values:', non_numeric)

# Look at Table S2 for organoid sensitivity data
rows_s2 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page10')
print('\nTable S2 header:', rows_s2[0] if rows_s2 else 'empty')
print('Table S2 row1:', rows_s2[1] if len(rows_s2)>1 else 'N/A')
print('Table S2 row2:', rows_s2[2] if len(rows_s2)>2 else 'N/A')
print('Table S2 ncols:', len(rows_s2[0]) if rows_s2 else 0)

# Check Table S5 for diagnostic test results
rows_s5 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page13')
print('\nTable S5:')
for i, r in enumerate(rows_s5[:10]):
    print(f'  Row {i}:', r)

# Check Table S3
rows_s3 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page11')
print('\nTable S3:')
for i, r in enumerate(rows_s3[:10]):
    print(f'  Row {i}:', r)
"}
